scope: Evidence triage and guided testing. This is not a vehicle service manual or a replacement-parts database.

ignition_feed_under_load.title: Measure the ignition feed directly through the stall
ignition_feed_under_load.method: Back-probe the affected ignition-feed circuit with a meter or scope while the engine runs and stalls. Record voltage, ground drop, RPM, and relay state together.
ignition_feed_under_load.pass: If direct voltage remains stable, treat the scanner zero as asynchronous or channel-specific and continue with cylinder misfire and injector tests.
ignition_feed_under_load.fail: If direct voltage drops with the stall, inspect the feed circuit, ignition switch path, fuse and relay terminals, connectors, grounds, and loaded voltage drop before replacing a component.
ignition_feed_under_load.unknown: Do not condemn a part from the scanner channel alone. Repeat with a direct synchronized measurement.

bank_imbalance.title: Separate Bank 2 fueling from combustion faults
bank_imbalance.method: Capture cylinder-specific misfire counters and both banks' trims at the same operating point, then perform an injector balance/leak test using the vehicle service procedure.
bank_imbalance.pass: If misfires and injector balance are even, investigate biased sensor data, exhaust leakage, wiring, or bank-specific control inputs.
bank_imbalance.fail: If one cylinder or Bank 2 fails the balance test, follow the evidence to that circuit or cylinder; confirm wiring and mechanical condition before replacing an injector or coil.
bank_imbalance.unknown: Obtain cylinder-specific misfire counts and a controlled injector test; fuel-rail pressure alone cannot exclude an injector fault.

loop_transition.title: Reproduce the open-to-closed-loop transition
loop_transition.method: Record RPM, loop state, both upstream oxygen sensors, short- and long-term trims, MAF, MAP, injector command, and ignition feed from startup through the stall.
loop_transition.pass: If the stall does not repeat at the transition, compare the conditions with the failing capture before changing parts.
loop_transition.fail: If it repeats, identify which measured input or command changes first. Correlation with closed loop alone does not prove an oxygen sensor fault.
loop_transition.unknown: Record a synchronized transition with the exact method used to force open loop documented.

fuel_quality.title: Verify fuel quality even when rail pressure is steady
fuel_quality.method: Following fire-safe service procedures, obtain a representative fuel sample in an approved clear container. Inspect after settling for water separation, debris, unusual color or odor, and compare with known-good fuel. If available, use a suitable fuel-composition or contamination test.
fuel_quality.pass: If the sample is clean and correct, retain the pressure evidence and continue with synchronized ignition, injector balance, and combustion tests.
fuel_quality.fail: If contamination, water, phase separation, or incorrect fuel is confirmed, follow the manufacturer-approved drain, disposal, flush, refill, and verification procedure. Do not run contaminated fuel through the system to test it.
fuel_quality.unknown: Normal rail pressure cannot establish fuel quality. Mark fuel quality unconfirmed until a representative sample is inspected or tested.
